Server rejects unknown source before saving or consuming the result
Server rejects missing source before saving or consuming the result
Server rejects unknown fields before saving or consuming the result
Server rejects malformed item before saving or consuming the result
Server rejects unknown alternative before saving or consuming the result
Named activity/meal/stay proposals replace literal request paragraphs while retaining separate original sources
Compound request coverage requires both its church visit and its concrete meal arrangement
Ambiguous place interpretation and Phase2 rental condition are disclosed to their owner and need explicit exclusion acknowledgement
Outsider/unverified callers cannot read contextual trip data
Contextual version still requires each owner review before organiser lock

Old literal and new contextual locked history remain immutable and readable
